'''Soly Kantt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived with his family on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Kantt worked at [[Orbital Assembly Facility 7/Legends|Orbital Assembly Facility 7]] for the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], which he had been with since [[70 BBY/Legends|70 BBY]].<ref>Based on the events taking place in [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]], and having worked with the company for ten years.</ref> In [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]], he was on shift at Orbital 7 when the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], at the time designated YT 492727ZED, wrought havoc on the assembly line during testing as a result of a [[Fuel droid/Legends|fuel droid]] failing to detach in time and overfilling the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300's]] [[Fuel cell/Legends|fuel cells]].
